depicted_variant: Zhuyin dari Shanhaijing: wajah manusia, tubuh ular merah seribu li, berdiam di kaki Gunung Zhong; mata membuka siang dan napas menjadi angin.

visual_requirements.description: Satu wajah manusia dan tubuh ular merah tanpa anggota tubuh; skala seribu li.
Mata terbuka membawa siang, hembusan napas menggerakkan angin di lereng.
Kaki Gunung Zhong, tubuh memanjang menutup jajaran pegunungan.

aura: Keagungan datang dari tubuh seribu li dan siang serta angin yang bergerak bersama tatapan dan napas Zhuyin (zhulong-mythology-c07, zhulong-mythology-c08).
artistic_choices: Varian Mount Zhong dipilih tanpa mencampur lokasi Huainanzi atau ikonografi naga modern.
Dua mata manusia, kepala tunggal, tubuh tanpa kaki/lengan/sayap/tanduk; jumlah anatomi wajar dipilih editorial.
Palet merah gelap/walnut/emas dan foreshortening adalah editorial; angin diperlihatkan melalui pepohonan dan debu, bukan pita cahaya.
Tatapan terbuka dengan cahaya siang menembus gelap merupakan visualisasi editorial klaim pergantian siang; bukan sinar laser mata.
prompt:
ONE original square premium painterly cinematic Mythics illustration of ZHUYIN / ZHULONG, the red human-faced serpent god of Mount Zhong in the Shanhaijing.
ANATOMY: exactly ONE HUMAN FACE with TWO human eyes, NO serpentine animal head; an immense RED SNAKE BODY a thousand li long extends and coils across mountains; absolutely NO ARMS, LEGS, WINGS, HORNS, beard tendrils or accessories. The human face seamlessly joins the snake neck, not a human torso. [zhulong-mythology-c07,c08]
MOMENT: the colossal face leans forward and opens both eyes toward the viewer, exhaling a powerful wind that bends whole forests beneath his face.
POWER: opening his eyes makes DAY, breath becomes WIND; daylight breaks across formerly dark mountain slopes while trees bend, loose earth and clouds are driven away physically. NO eyebeams, glowing pupils or magic rings. [zhulong-mythology-c07]
SCALE & CAMERA: extreme low angle from tiny mountain trees; huge human face and red serpent neck fill most of the square, long coils eclipse the distant ridges.
LIGHT & WEATHER: one warm shaft of new daylight breaking darkness, deep walnut shadow, wind-driven dust and cloud.
SURFACE: weathered solemn human features, richly textured dark red scales and rough mountain stone.
SETTING: foot of Mount Zhong, immense mountain country. [zhulong-mythology-c08]
MOOD: divine authority, reverent and overwhelming, awake and actively controlling the world, never evil caricature or ordinary man.

HARD CONSTRAINTS: square at least1024px; no text, lettering, glyphs, inscriptions, logo, border, frame or watermark; no extra heads, limbs or fingers; no design borrowed from films, games, anime or comics; no nudity, exposed breasts or explicit gore; no generic glow aura, neon outlines, floating runes or energy ribbons.
rationale: Every illustration must feel 'sangar': dangerous, imposing or awe-inspiring, with the being as the undeniable subject. The owner rejected earlier images that read as an ordinary person, an ordinary animal, an empty landscape, or a calm, cute or decorative portrait. Those outcomes are failures regardless of technical quality.

visual_review.notes: Native dan 200px diperiksa: satu wajah manusia dengan dua mata, tubuh ular merah tanpa kaki/lengan/sayap/tanduk, skala menutupi pegunungan. Hembusan menggerakkan pohon/debu dan cahaya siang sesuai zhulong-mythology-c07; aksi dominan dan agung, bukan pose atau aura neon. Tidak ada tulisan/gore/anatomi tambahan.

root_visual_review.notes: Human face on a vast red limbless serpent body draped over mountain ridges, its breath sweeping wind through the pines.
